paite: Huai lai in, kuate hiam a-om ua, huaite'n Pilat in Galili mite asisan uh Pathian biakna sagohte lak a ahelsakte tungtang Jesu ahilh uhi.
heading: Kisik Ding A Thu Pia / (Mat 12.1-5)
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huai Galili mite huchibang thil athuak ziak un Galili mi tengteng sang in migilou tuan hi un na gingta ua hia?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

paite: Hilou e, ka hon hilh ahi, nou leng na kisik kei uleh huchi mah bang in na mangthang vek ding uhi.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

paite: Huan Siloam insang in mi sawm-le-giat adelhlupte leng Jerusalem a om tengteng sang in migilouzaw hi un na gingta ua hia?
english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

paite: Hilou e, ka hon hilh ahi, nou leng na kisik kei uleh huchibang mah in na mangthang vek ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

paite: Huan hiai gentehna agen a, "Kuahiam in agrephuan ah theipi kung khat asuan hi. Huan akung ah gah ahong zong a khat leng amu kei hi.
heading: Theipi Kung Hut Gentehna
english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

paite: Huchi in grephuan kemmi kiang ah, 'Ngai in, kum thum sung hiai theipi kung ah agah ka va zong zel a, khat leng ka mu kei; phuk in; bangziak a mun dal a om nilouh ahia?' achi hi.
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

paite: Ama'n akiang ah 'Pu, tukum bek om henla, akimvel in ka tou ding a, ek in ka phungvuh lai dia;
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

paite: huchi a agahleh ahoih ding, agah kei laileh phuk mai in,' " achi hi.
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

paite: Huan Sabbath ni in ama'n sinagog khat ah thu ahilh hi.
heading: Sabbath Ni A Numei Hihdamna
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

paite: Ngai in, kum sawm-le-giat hatlouhna nei dawimat numei khat a-om a; huai mi akun kheukheu a, a-ut thu in adingtang thei kei hi.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

paite: Jesu'n amah amuhtak in asam a, akiang ah, "Numei, na hatlouhna in ahon khahta," achi hi.
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

paite: Huan atung ah akhut akoih a; thakhat in atang pah a, Pathian aphatta hi.
english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

paite: Jesu'n Sabbath ni a mi ahihdam ziak in sinagog heutu aheh a, mipi ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Mihing nasepna ding ni guk a-om vo oi; huai sung in kihihdam un, Sabbath ni in hilou in," achi hi.
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

paite: Toupa'n akiang ah, "Nou lepchiahte aw, Sabbath ni in na bawng uh hiam na sabiltung uh hiam a-an nekna a kipan phel in, tui dawn ding in na pikhe chiat zel uh hilou hia?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

paite: Hiai numei, Abraham tanu ahi ngal a, ngai un, Setan in kum sawm-le-giat aman a, Sabbath ni in leng hiai gak phelsak louh dan ahi a hia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

paite: Huai thute agen lai in amelma tengteng azum ua; mipi bel athil thupi hih tengteng ziak in akipak uhi.
english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Pathian lalgam bang ahia? Bang toh ka teh dia?
heading: Ankam Chi Leh Silngou Gentehna / (Mat 13.31-32; Mar 4.30-32)
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

paite: Ankam chi tang khat mi'n alak a, huan a atheh bang ahi, huai ahong pou a, sing ahong hi a, ahiangte ah tungleng vasate agiak uh," achi hi.
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

paite: Huan "Pathian lalgam bang toh ka teh dia? achi nawn a.
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

paite: Silngou numei in alak a, anbuang tehna thum lak a avek a athoh mateng aphum bang ahi," achi hi.
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

paite: Huan ama'n thu hilh kawm zel in, Jerusalem kholam naih in kholian leh khoneute a tawn zel hi.
heading: Kong Kochik / (Mat 7.13-14,21-23)
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

paite: Kuahiam in akiang ah, "Hotdamte tawmchik ahi ding uh maw? achi hi.
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, kong kochik ah lut tum teitei un; ka hon hilh ahi, mi tampi in lut atum ding ua, alut thei kei ding uh.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

paite: Inn neipa athoh a, kong akhak nung in, nou apua a dingh in, 'Toupa, kong hon hon in, chi a kongkhak na hon kiuh chiang un, ama'n koilam mi na hi ua, hon thei lou ka hi' chi in nou ahon dawng ding hi.
english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

paite: Huai hun chiang in, nou, 'Na muh in ka ne ua, ka dawn ve ua oi, ka kongzing uah leng thu na hilh zel vo oi,' chi in na gen pan ding uh.
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

paite: Ama'n, 'Ka hon hilh ahi, koilam mi na hi ua, ka hon thei ngei kei; nou thil gilou hihte aw, ka kiang a pan paimang vek un,' ahon chi ding hi.
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

paite: Pathian lalgam sung a Abraham, Isak, Jakob leh zawlnei tengteng om na muh ua, nou polam a delhkhiak a om na hih lam uh na kitheih chiang un, na kap ding ua, ha na gawi ding uhi.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

paite: Huan suahlam, tumlam, simlam leh mallam a kipan mite ahong pai ding ua, Pathian lalgam ah ne in adawn ding uhi.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

paite: Huan ngai un, ananungpente leng amasapen a om a-om ding ua, amasapente leng ananungpen a om ding a-om uh," achi hi.
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

paite: Huaitak in Pharisai kuate hiam ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Pawt inla, hiai a kipan paimang in; Herod in thah hon sawm ahi,” achi uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Khua Jesu'n Akahkhum / (Mat 23.37-38)
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huai sehal kiang ah hiai thu va gen un, 'Ngai in, tuni toh, zingchiang toh dawite ka delhkhe dia, natnate leng ka hihdam lai dia, ani thum ni in ka zou ding.
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh tuni toh, zingchiang toh, ani thum ni toh ka pai zel lai ding; Jerusalem kho polam ah zawlnei amanthat thil hi thei hilou ahi.'
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

paite: Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem; zawlneite that, na kiang a hon sawlte suang a na denglum; akpi in anoute akha nuai a a-opkhum bang in na tate bangzah vei opkhum ka tum a? Himahleh na ut kei uhi.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

paite: En in, na inn avuak a taihsan in a-omta. Ka hon hilh ahi, 'Toupa min a hong pai ahampha, na chih masiah na hon mu kei ding, " achi hi.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
